query:
INSERT INTO thread (board_id, subject, author_id, created_at, last_post_at)
               SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $4
               WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board WHERE id = $1)
                 AND ($5::BIGINT IS NULL
                      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM post WHERE author_id = $3 AND created_at >= $6) < $5)
               RETURNING id AS "id!"
